free_tier.stated: Free tier: 50 GB of 'dung lượng không đảm bảo' (non-guaranteed capacity). From 2027-01-01 the platform rebrands to FshareStorage, guaranteed capacity rises 50 GB -> 100 GB, and **the free account tier is discontinued entirely**.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Free accounts terminated 2027-01-01; data on any free account surviving to that date is kept a maximum of 30 days.

egress.terms: Download speed capped at 500 KB/s on Free ('Tốc độ tải xuống với 500KB/s'), which is per-ip-shaping in practice. VIP is 300 GB and sold from 3,000 VND/day.

tooling: Web + Windows/sync client. No public API, no rclone backend. FPT is the parent ISP.
chaining: 50 GB x N FPT accounts, all of it non-guaranteed — but this is a closing door, not an opening one: free accounts stop existing in ~2 months.
limits_note: per-ip-shaping: 500 KB/s download on Free. 50 GB non-guaranteed storage. Free accounts terminated 2027-01-01; data on any free account surviving to that date is kept a maximum of 30 days.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: The single most important thing about Fshare is the dated announcement: the free tier is being killed on 2027-01-01 and free-tier data gets a 30-day guillotine regardless of download activity. Anything built on it has a hard expiry date two months out.
